prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory-only; command-authority/continuity preserved. Actors: local fire agencies/county emergency management/state wildland fire resources/aviation support units/cooperating public safety partners. North Lookout Camera Mast→Thermal Spot Snippet/bearings; South Lookout Camera Mast→triangulation/Camera Cleaning Log; both→health. Smoke Classifier Module→smoke/growth/confidence/Ridge Shadow Mask; contamination-checks; degraded imagery advisory/non-aviation. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine(Lantern)→traceable detections/perimeters/recommendations/hazards/probability-bands; degradation-downweighted; exposure-refresh needs valid reconnaissance/weather-timing; repository-outage retains approved configuration/rejects unsigned/unversioned analytics. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node(Brindle)→terrain-weather/Wind Shift Bulletin/exposure-flags/cache. Caldera Incident Command Portal(Emberhall)→triage/approval/assignments; mandatory perimeter/priority-review. Duty Detection Officer(Orion) verifies/receives stale/partial-coverage warnings. Confirmation: persistent smoke/thermal+independent corroboration/authorized judgment; searchable dismissals; Confirmed Ignition State≠dispatch. Disconnected operating mode: timestamped cache/queues; irreversible-release blocked. Crewline Mobile Tablet: encrypted queues; reconciliation preserves author/device-time/server-acceptance-time. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock(Kestrel)→readiness/health/recovery; maintenance controller→Battery Swap Ticket. Drone Tasking Service→missions/windows/images/altitudes/abort-criteria/status; degraded-communications automated-release requires corridor-permit. Drone Pilot Operator checks endurance/routes/return/separation; readiness≠assignment. Imagery requires weather/airspace/communications-clearance/orthorectification/grid-registration. Air Attack Supervisor(Redtail) authorizes aviation; Airspace Restricted State requires accepted routes/altitudes/helitack-boundary. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console(Marigold) blocks unapproved/unready-release→Runway Release Note/Suppression Drop Receipt. Tanker Base Manager reconciles East Retardant Loading Pump→Retardant Batch Slip; East/West Retardant Loading Pump→state/flow/outages; loading≠approval. Records: policy-retention; shorter-approved raw-sensor retention; encryption/controlled-export/authorized-documented-deletion. Training mandatory: all operational users—VHF Radio Gateway Repeater

New part:
S225: The deployment governance board shall include operational leadership, maintenance representation, information security representation, and designated representatives for detection, aviation, ground crew, and county coordination functions.
S226: The board shall approve each seasonal rollout only after reviewing residual risk, staffing readiness, configuration baselines, and open corrective actions from the prior operating period.
S227: A release candidate shall not enter operational service until the Caldera Incident Command Portal, Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine, and Smoke Classifier Module complete documented functional testing against the approved mission scenarios.
S228: Acceptance criteria shall require the North Lookout Camera Mast, South Lookout Camera Mast, and MesoWest Weather Fusion Node to meet agreed availability, timing, and data-quality thresholds during the readiness window.
S229: The Drone Tasking Service and Horizon Ridge Drone Dock shall be accepted only after controlled field validation shows that task execution, abort behavior, and status reporting remain stable under expected seasonal conditions.
S230: The Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console, East Retardant Loading Pump, and West Retardant Loading Pump shall pass integration checks that verify operator controls, fault handling, and audit capture before activation.
S231: The VHF Radio Gateway Repeater and Crewline Mobile Tablet shall be validated for coverage, message persistence, authentication behavior, and degraded-network operation before release approval.
S232: Redtail shall confirm that deployment readiness evidence is sufficient before air operations functionality is enabled for the season.
S233: The Tanker Base Manager shall use the Runway Release Note during acceptance review to verify that tanker-base operating constraints are documented before seasonal activation.
S234: The County Emergency Liaison shall use the Suppression Drop Receipt during post-incident reconciliation to verify that reported suppression activity can be traced to county situation reporting.
S235: Acceptance of the Confirmed Ignition State workflow shall require traceable evidence that operator acknowledgement, escalation timing, and command visibility meet the approved concept of operations.
S236: Acceptance of the Airspace Restricted State workflow shall require evidence that operational users can recognize restrictions, apply required controls, and recover normal coordination when restrictions are lifted.
S237: Any waiver to acceptance criteria shall identify the operational impact, compensating procedure, expiration date, and accountable owner before the board may authorize limited use.
S238: After-action reviews shall be held after major incidents, readiness exercises, significant false alarms, missed detections, and any event that exposes a gap in operational coordination.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
